subject: Priv deploy IaC — anchored module gating & signed artifact evidence
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
To: ops-team@acmecloud.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Priv deploy IaC — anchored module gating & signed artifact evidence

Hi Sarah / Acme infra team,

Thanks again for walking through the network topology last week. Before we proceed with the private deployment pilot, our compliance and runtime teams need a short checklist validated for the IaC bundle we'll be installing into Acme's VPC. Specifically we need: 

1) Support for pinned/anchored module digests (not just tags) in your module registry so we can declare exact module artifact digests in our Terraform module inputs.
2) Ability for us to upload a signed manifest (opaque file) that the CI pipeline verifies before applying (we'll provide an example manifest format).
3) Minimal service account scope guidance for the bootstrap jobs so we can run with least privilege (list of required IAM roles).
4) CI job templates that run a signed-artifact verify step and a dry-run (terraform plan + helm template) in a transient canary project before any production workspace.

Attached: iac-evidence-checklist.pdf (our checklist), anchored-modules-manifest.json (example manifest), ci-job-templates.yaml (skeleton CI jobs).

Can you confirm which of the above you can support out of the box and which will require small changes on your side? If there are gaps, please indicate mitigations (e.g., short-lived pre-signed URLs, delegated token exchange). We need a confirmation or a short remediation plan by COB Tuesday (2026-11-02) so we can schedule the rollout window.

Appreciate it —
Laura Bennett
Head of Private Deployments (Interim)
Redwood Inference
---

From: Ops Team <ops-team@acmecloud.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmecloud.com>, procure@acmecloud.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priv deploy IaC — anchored module gating & signed artifact evidence

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers inline below and an initial timeline: 

On Mon, 1 Nov 2026, Laura Bennett wrote:
> 1) Support for pinned/anchored module digests (not just tags) in your module registry

We support SHA256-based digests for all published modules in our private registry; tagging is independent of digest pinning. We can expose a digest lookup API if you prefer automation.

> 2) Ability to upload a signed manifest (opaque file) that the CI pipeline verifies before applying

We don’t currently have a built-in signed-manifest verify hook in our managed pipelines, but we can add a verification step in the pre-apply runner. Proposal: you provide the verification binary or container; we wire it into the pre-apply stage. That work is scoped to ~3 dev days.

> 3) Minimal service account scope guidance for the bootstrap jobs

Attached is a minimal role map we maintain for partners (we'll follow up with exact role ARNs). Short version: separate bootstrap SA with only create/attach ENI, create/delete temporary per-namespace resources, and read-only access to KMS keys used to verify signatures.

> 4) CI job templates that run a signed-artifact verify step and a dry-run in a transient canary project

We can accept CI job YAML (your templates) and convert them to our runners. We suggest using a dedicated canary project prefix (acme-priv-canary-*) that is auto-cleaned after N hours.

Timeline: we can deliver the CI hook and role ARNs by 2026-11-05 EOD once we get access to your verification container and the signed manifest spec. Procurement noted a small change to our partner agreement (section 4.2) — they're looped in.

Regards,
Acme Ops (on behalf of Sarah Jenkins)
Ops Team, Acme Cloud

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priv deploy IaC — anchored module gating & signed artifact evidence

Thanks — looping in quick operational items from our side: 

• I'll add a GitLab pre-merge pipeline job that fails if anchored module digests aren't present in the module registry input.
• Creating a single-use service account template (json) scoped to bootstrap activities; will attach to PR: PRIV-642.
• I created the Jira ticket PRIV-642 (see link) to track the CI hook work and the manifest verification container delivery.

Next actions for me: push the SA template and pipeline job by EOD today, then coordinate with Acme's ops for the verification container image name.

-rishi
Engineering Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com, ops-team@acmecloud.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priv deploy IaC — anchored module gating & signed artifact evidence

Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround. Two clarifications before we close the loop: 

1) Can we make the pre-apply verification step idempotent and non-blocking in read-only environments (staging) but blocking for prod workspaces? We'll model this with a CI variable (VERIFY_STRICT=true/false).
2) For evidence collection, procurement asked that we produce a single ZIP containing the signed manifest, module digests (sha256 list), and the pipeline job run log for the canary. Please point me to the S3 path you'll accept or confirm we should upload to our bucket and share a presigned URL.

If Acme confirms the pipeline hook timeline on Friday (2026-11-05) we can run a canary the following week (targeting 2026-11-10). Grace — please prepare the runbook template (canary checklist + rollback commands) and attach it to PRIV-642 when ready.

Thanks — I'll wait for Acme's confirmation on timeline and the S3 presigned path.

Laura Bennett
Head of Private Deployments (Interim)
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: iac-evidence-checklist.pdf, anchored-modules-manifest.json, ci-job-templates.yaml
